description: Per-namespace retrieval-verification dataset for the kyberswap namespace (4 live tools). Every live tool has blind rows (no brand word) and protocol-aware rows (brand named). Queries were written from the manifests and the navigation entry only, phrased the way a model would type them into tool search on the user's behalf. Generic swap-pricing rows are deliberately worded like the sibling uniswap dataset's rows so the venue-pair behaviour (D11: both venues' quote tools returning close together for a plain swap query) is observable.

queries.query: price 2 ETH into USDC on Arbitrum before trading, show the rate and price impact
how much WETH would I get for 500 USDC on Base right now, no signing

buy WETH with 250 DAI on Ethereum through KyberSwap and broadcast it
